name: Raman spectra of pure glucose liquid at 14 glucose levels (5 samples each, 70 spectra) from a Raman spectrometer at Vietnam National University, Hanoi (Ngo 2024, Mendeley Data doi:10.17632/yk75sxk6p5.1)
description: The deposit's 'dense' 14-level set: 70 raw Raman spectra of pure glucose liquid (5 samples x 14 glucose levels; Ngo Quang Tri, Vietnam National University, Hanoi; Mendeley Data doi:10.17632/yk75sxk6p5.1, v1, 2024-02-29, CC BY 4.0, no related publication). Task: classification by the deposit's level-designation labels - M50, M52, M54, M55, M56, M58, M60, M62, M64, M65, M66, M68, M70, M75 (14 classes, 5 spectra each). The labels clearly encode a monotonic glucose-concentration ladder (the mean spectrum changes monotonically across levels), but the unit convention is not documented in the deposit, so no numeric-concentration regression target is exposed. IMPORTANT: the deposit contains NO wavenumber calibration - the data CSVs are bare intensity rows (2,030 columns each) without an axis, and no instrument model, excitation or spectral range is recorded anywhere in the deposit - so the exposed axis is the 0-based column index (detector pixel order, 0..2,029) and the spectral direction is undetermined. Spectra are raw as deposited (arbitrary units, -439..48,131 across the 70 rows, a few negative baseline points); no baseline correction, normalization or resampling applied. The five samples per level are treated as independent (the deposit does not document their preparation), so is_grouped=False. Served from frozen copies mirrored at HTW-KI-Werkstatt/RamanBench (glucose_liquid/): Mendeley Data 403-blocks non-browser clients (including CI). The companion 'spare' 10-level set (50 spectra, 2,048 columns, levels 05M..150M) is the glucose_liquid_10level key.

rai:dataCollection: Raman measurements of pure glucose liquid at 14 fixed glucose levels (5 samples per level) on a large-size Raman spectrometer at Vietnam National University, Hanoi; raw spectra as exported, 2,030 detector columns per spectrum.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: No preprocessing was applied by the authors (raw spectra as deposited). The raman_data loader only reads the bare intensity CSV, joins it row-wise with the deposit's label file (verified: 5 spectra per level, consistent label names), and exposes the 0-based column index as the axis; no baseline correction, smoothing or normalization is applied.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Labels are the deposit's own level-designation strings from the label file's 'Label name' column (M50, M52, M54, M55, M56, M58, M60, M62, M64, M65, M66, M68, M70, M75; 5 spectra per level); no re-labelling was performed for this benchmark. The levels clearly encode a monotonic glucose-concentration ladder, but the unit convention is not documented in the deposit.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No personal or sensitive information is included. All samples are pure glucose liquid at defined levels.
rai:dataBiases: The spectra carry NO wavenumber calibration (bare intensity rows; no instrument model, excitation or spectral range recorded), so any Raman-shift-dependent analysis is impossible; the exposed axis is the 0-based column (detector pixel) index and the spectral direction is undetermined. The five samples per level may be repeat measurements of the same solution (correlated) or independent preparations - the deposit does not say; either way level == class here. Raw counts with negative baseline points (-439 minimum); absolute intensity scales are instrument-specific.
rai:dataLimitations: No wavenumber calibration in the deposit (axis is an uncalibrated detector-pixel index); spectral direction undetermined; the level-designation labels have an undocumented unit convention, so no numeric concentration target is exposed; small balanced design (14 classes x 5 spectra); raw counts with negative baseline points (-439..48,131); no instrument parameters recorded.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Supports non-invasive glucose monitoring research (Raman-based glucose level discrimination). No personal or medical data; pure glucose liquid samples.
rai:dataUseCases: Classification of 14 glucose level designations from raw Raman spectra (5 replicates per level); preprocessing and model-robustness benchmarks (the uncalibrated axis makes this a shape-based classification task); the 10-level companion set is the glucose_liquid_10level key.
